5114 tomoteros {tom-o'-ter-os}

字根型 temno 衍生字的比較級 
(切割, 比 SNG02875　更明確的表達方式, 有一刀下去就了結的意思, 而 SNG02875　則有反覆劈砍的意思); 形容詞

欽定本 - sharper 1; 1

1) 更銳利的 (#來4:12|)
record.edic_text:
5114 tomoteros {tom-o'-ter-os}

comparative of a derivative of the primary temno (to cut, more
   comprehensive or decisive than 2875, as if by a single stroke,
   whereas that implies repeated blows, like hacking);; adj

AV - sharper 1; 1

1) sharper
